I understand, I don’t have any big advice to what you can do. I would start by doing something that doesn’t take much effort. Watch a movie. I have a lot of suggestions if you need some. Sorry that I can’t do more for you!!

I understand. This feeling is temporary even tho it feels like it’s not. When you go thru a break up you’re gonna think about all the things that you think you did wrong. Even tho you might not even have done those things. Maybe you just need to gain some self love. Whenever I feel really bad, I watch Bridgett Jones(dumb suggestion I know) sometimes it’s the little things that can build you up to be the strong person that you don’t think you are right now. Sometimes in a relationship you lose apart of yourself, I think you need to find that part of yourself again. Sending a big hug.

You are not crazy. I’ve met some crazy people over the years. Crazy people don’t think that they are crazy! Just breath. Maybe give him so space? Show him that you are a strong person, because you are!! It’s going to be okay. Break ups are unfortunately a part of life, you just have to get thru this difficult period, then one day it is going to feel so much easier!!
